subject.title: Feature request: message delete (revoke) action for WhatsApp channel

question: Should the bundled WhatsApp plugin expose bot-owned message deletion/revocation, and if so what public action name and safety contract should it use?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but destructive WhatsApp mutation needs maintainer intent for action naming, own-message constraints, expiry behavior, and proof expectations before automation should create replacement work.

options.title: Sponsor constrained WhatsApp delete
options.body: Keep this issue open and review the linked PR or an equivalent patch that implements bot-owned delete/revoke with strict target authorization, fromMe handling, group participant rules, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Defer destructive mutation
options.body: Leave the request open but postpone implementation until live WhatsApp behavior and silent-failure modes are better understood.

options.title: Reject programmatic revoke
options.body: Close the request if maintainers decide agents should not programmatically revoke WhatsApp messages because ambiguous failure is too risky.

recommendation.title: Sponsor constrained WhatsApp delete
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and review the linked PR or an equivalent patch that implements bot-owned delete/revoke with strict target authorization, fromMe handling, group participant rules, and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue as the canonical tracker and has recent history on the WhatsApp action/docs surfaces.
